name: Free Movement of Goods
description: Aligning Ukrainian product standards, technical regulations, and conformity assessment with EU norms. Screening completed September 2025; chapter part of Cluster 2 (Internal Market). Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Freedom of Movement for Workers
description: Part of Cluster 2 (Internal Market). Screening completed 2025. Draft Common Position received December 2025. Establishing rights for Ukrainian workers in the EU and vice versa, including mutual recognition of professional qualifications. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Right of Establishment and Freedom to Provide Services
description: Opening markets for businesses and service providers, including financial, postal, and professional services. Part of Cluster 2 (Internal Market). Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Free Movement of Capital
description: Part of Cluster 2 (Internal Market). Screening completed 2025. Draft Common Position received December 2025. Liberalising capital flows, harmonising rules on foreign investment, and aligning anti-money-laundering frameworks. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Public Procurement
description: Part of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals). Screening completed 2024. Draft Common Position received December 2025. Ukraine's ProZorro procurement system is widely praised as a model for transparency.

name: Company Law
description: Harmonising corporate legislation, accounting standards, and corporate governance requirements with EU company law. Screening completed 2025. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Intellectual Property Law
description: Strengthening IP protection including patents, trademarks, copyright, and enforcement mechanisms. Screening completed 2025. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Competition Policy
description: Bringing state aid rules and antitrust enforcement in line with EU competition law. Screening completed 2025. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Financial Services
description: Aligning banking, insurance, and investment regulations with EU financial services directives. Screening completed 2025. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Information Society and Media
description: Updating rules on electronic communications, audiovisual media services, and digital single market alignment. Screening completed 2025. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Agriculture and Rural Development
description: Part of Cluster 5 (Resources, Agriculture & Cohesion). Screening completed 2025. Reforming agricultural policy, food safety standards, and rural development programs to meet Common Agricultural Policy standards.

name: Food Safety, Veterinary and Phytosanitary Policy
description: Part of Cluster 5 (Resources, Agriculture & Cohesion). Screening completed 2025. Implementing EU food safety standards, sanitary controls, and phytosanitary measures across the food chain.

name: Fisheries
description: Aligning fisheries management, conservation, and control measures with the EU's Common Fisheries Policy. Screening completed 2025.

name: Transport Policy
description: Harmonising road, rail, air, and inland waterway transport rules, including safety standards and market access. Part of Cluster 4.

name: Energy
description: Part of Cluster 4 (Green Agenda). Screening completed 2025. Ukraine joined ENTSO-E (European electricity grid) in March 2022, physically connecting to Europe's energy network. Aligning energy market, renewables legislation, and nuclear safety with EU acquis.

name: Taxation
description: Harmonising VAT, excise duties, and direct taxation with EU tax acquis and OECD standards. Part of Cluster 3 (Competitiveness & Inclusive Growth). Screening completed 2025. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Economic and Monetary Policy
description: Aligning macroeconomic frameworks, central bank independence, and preparing for eventual eurozone integration. Part of Cluster 3. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Statistics
description: Part of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals). Screening completed 2024. Draft Common Position received December 2025. Ukraine's State Statistics Service produces data comparable with Eurostat standards, rated 'some level of preparation' by the EC.

name: Social Policy and Employment
description: Updating labour law, health and safety at work, and social dialogue mechanisms to meet EU standards. Part of Cluster 3. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Enterprise and Industrial Policy
description: Improving the business environment, supporting SMEs, and aligning industrial policy with EU competitiveness goals. Part of Cluster 3. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Trans-European Networks
description: Integrating Ukrainian transport and energy infrastructure into Trans-European Networks (TEN-T and TEN-E). Part of Cluster 4.

name: Regional Policy and Coordination of Structural Instruments
description: Building capacity to implement cohesion policy, manage structural funds, and reduce regional disparities. Part of Cluster 5.

name: Judiciary and Fundamental Rights
description: Core chapter of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals). Screening completed 2024. Draft Common Position received December 2025. Covers judicial reform, Constitutional Court reform, anti-corruption institutions (NABU, SAPO, HACC), and protection of fundamental rights.

name: Justice, Freedom and Security
description: Part of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals). Screening completed 2024. Draft Common Position received December 2025. Covers border management, migration rules, asylum policy, anti-money laundering, and police and judicial cooperation.

name: Science and Research
description: Part of Cluster 3 (Competitiveness & Inclusive Growth). Screening completed 2025. Ukraine is fully associated with Horizon Europe since 2022, participating in EU research funding on equal terms with member states. Rated 'moderately prepared' by the EC. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Education and Culture
description: Expanding participation in Erasmus+, aligning higher education with Bologna Process, and cultural cooperation. Part of Cluster 3. Screening completed 2025. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Environment and Climate Change
description: Implementing EU environmental directives on water, air, waste, biodiversity, and aligning with the European Green Deal commitments. Part of Cluster 4.

name: Consumer and Health Protection
description: Strengthening consumer rights enforcement and aligning public health and pharmaceutical regulations with EU standards. Part of Cluster 2. Screening completed 2025. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: Customs Union
description: Modernising Ukrainian customs procedures, IT systems, and aligning with the EU Customs Code. Part of Cluster 3. Hungary declined to approve the screening results for this cluster at the Council enlargement working party (COELA) on 17 and 22 July 2026; the decision was postponed to 1 September 2026.

name: External Relations
description: Trade policy, development cooperation and humanitarian aid, and alignment with EU external action. Negotiations opened on 14 July 2026 at the Third EU-Ukraine Accession Conference in Brussels, where Cluster 6 (External Relations) became the second cluster opened after Fundamentals.

name: Foreign, Security and Defence Policy
description: Alignment with the EU Common Foreign and Security Policy and the Common Security and Defence Policy, including sanctions regimes and restrictive measures. Negotiations opened on 14 July 2026 as part of Cluster 6 (External Relations), alongside chapter 30.

name: Financial Control
description: Part of Cluster 1 (Fundamentals). Screening completed 2024. Draft Common Position received December 2025. Establishing public internal financial control systems and aligning with EU audit and accountability standards.

name: Finance and Budgetary Provisions
description: Preparing administrative capacity to manage EU budget contributions and structural fund financing. Part of Cluster 5.

name: Institutions
description: Institutional arrangements for Ukraine's participation in the EU institutions after accession — seats in the European Parliament, Council voting weight, and Commission representation. Handled outside the six thematic clusters and settled at the end of the negotiations.

name: Other Matters
description: Residual issues that do not fall under any other chapter, resolved in the final stage of negotiations. Handled outside the six thematic clusters.
